verdict.rationale: Plaid IDV documents integrate with a separate 'Monitor' product that checks watchlists/PEP lists, implying some ongoing screening capability, and IDV does support webhook events (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) for real-time alerts — but these events are scoped to the one-time verification flow, not to continuous re-screening of already-verified users against new watchlist hits. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Monitor re-screening previously verified users over time, dedicated watchlist-change webhook/event types, and any independent confirmation that ongoing re-screening actually fires actionable events.
